_about: Hand-curated, human-reviewable classification of each PSI combustion investigation. Every entry states its basis. Roles: prevention (material flammability / ignition), detection (smoke & aerosol), suppression (extinguishment), fundamental (combustion science & model validation), modeling (ground-based re-analysis of flight data). Edit this file, then re-run pipeline/build_dataset.py.

sources.challenge: NASA Space Apps 2026 'Flame in Freefall' challenge statement (Background + Potential Considerations)
sources.psi: PSI investigation record (objectives / approach / hardware fields)

PSI-10.basis: challenge: six ACME experiments, gaseous fuels, same ACME hardware in the CIR; factsheet: ACME secondary objective is spacecraft fire prevention

PSI-20.basis: challenge: BRE 'was a study of materials flammability in still atmospheres as a function of material properties'

PSI-21.basis: challenge + psi: ACME laminar gaseous non-premixed flames

PSI-22.basis: challenge: 'Partial gravity was mimicked in ACME's E-FIELD Flames experiment through the effect of the electric field on the ions'

PSI-23.basis: challenge + psi: ACME laminar gaseous flames

PSI-159.basis: challenge: CFI-G holds the highest-oxygen microgravity tests (oxygen-nitrogen up to 85% O2 from the burner)

PSI-25.basis: challenge: BASS-II flammability of solids; MSG with SPICE fan-driven flow duct

PSI-26.basis: psi objectives: (1) material flammability in microgravity, (2) effectiveness of an inert gaseous extinguishing agent

PSI-39.basis: challenge: FLEX, FLEX-2 and CFI burned liquid fuel droplets with the MDCA in the CIR

PSI-47.basis: challenge: an instrument from SAME/SAME-R was used to detect dust in DAFT and DAFT-2

PSI-68.basis: challenge: MDCA droplet experiments; psi table varies O2, pressure and flow

PSI-69.basis: challenge: 'Suppression was studied in FLEX through dilution of the chamber atmosphere with carbon dioxide and helium'

PSI-98.basis: challenge + factsheet: Saffire large-scale flame growth and material flammability in a Cygnus vehicle

PSI-99.basis: challenge + factsheet: Saffire-II nine samples incl. SIBAL, Nomex, PMMA, silicone

PSI-100.basis: challenge + factsheet: Saffire-III SIBAL at higher flow velocity

PSI-101.basis: challenge: fire detection tested in microgravity through SAME and SAME-R

PSI-102.basis: challenge: fire detection tested in microgravity through SAME and SAME-R

PSI-106.basis: challenge: SLICE conducted in the MSG using the SPICE flow duct; factsheet: ACME precursor

PSI-107.basis: challenge: SPICE in the MSG; psi sub-area 'Fire Safety'

PSI-60.basis: psi: ground investigation re-analysing SPICE data

PSI-62.basis: psi: concurrent flame spread modeling in microgravity

PSI-115.basis: psi: utilization of SAME data for advanced modeling

PSI-117.basis: psi: CFD of droplet cool flames using FLEX flight data

PSI-142.basis: psi: ground study using FLEX data on cool flame extinction
